bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/server-core
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "fda997ca2e008cea74ffed11955c3af9e2158462"
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in git@github.com:G-ACE-inc/server-core.git|https://github.com/G-ACE-inc/server-core.git) ;; *) exit 71;; esac
test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- scripts/servercore_result_sink.py tests/servercore_result_return_test.py docs/GITHUB_PROJECT_CHAT_HOST_ROUTE.md)"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-servercore-result-sink.service
printf 'SINK_PREFLIGHT_PASS\n'
